summary: Backend-only verification of the 4 approved enhancements (A deactivated-user guard, B escalation overdue coverage, C promo cadence back-off + pre-blast block-rate report, D admin media preview/confirm) plus regressions, all via the external ingress (https://cloud-integration-3.preview.emergentagent.com). Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_admin_media_confirm_suite.py (7 tests) — 7/7 PASSED. Verified independently with raw curl as well (run twice, deterministic). Endpoint results: /api/dev/admin-media-reply-test 9/9 checks true (regression intact after refactor); /api/dev/admin-media-confirm-test 10/10 (confirmHasHeading, confirmShowsTarget, confirmShowsCaption, confirmButtons amcSend/amcCancel, noCaptionLabel, guardDeactivated, guardBlocked, guardNotFound, guardBenignIsNull, guardEmptyIsNull); /api/dev/escalation-alert-plan-test 6/6 (abandonByAge, abandonByCount, skipNotDue, remindNotOverdue, remindOverdueCc, overdueCcNeedsSecondary); /api/dev/promo-cadence-test 10/10 (deactivatedNever/Infinity, notFound14, blocked1_7d, blocked2_30d, blocked3+_easedOff, other7d, reportRate 15.0%, reportAudience cloudphone/en + 'Will send: 800', reportBreakdown); regressions /api/dev/stale-wallet-tap-test pass:true and /api/dev/support-routing-test pass:true; GET /api/health -> healthy + database connected. No Telegram webhook was driven (per safety instruction) — no writes to the shared live DB, no real sends. Also code-reviewed the call sites: send() global catch -> _isPermanentTelegramSendError -> markUserDead + 'unreachable (reason)' log, unhandledRejection suppression, escalation tick consumes plan.overdue for the 'OVERDUE — customer waiting' banner and plan.ccSecondary gated on an explicitly configured _secondaryAdmin (no group leak), amcSend/amcCancel handler has a 10-min freshness guard + clears pendingAdminMedia + strips the keyboard, auto-promo isOptedOut uses _promoRetestTtlDays and recordSendFailure $inc blockCount, broadcastPromoForLang sends the pre-blast report inside try/catch. markUserDead correctly resolves autoPromo.setOptOut(chatId, optedOut, reason), which is exported by initAutoPromo.

minor.issue: Pre-existing and unrelated to this change: nodejs log repeatedly shows '[PhoneMonitor] Error checking number +18883304418: Request failed with status code 401' (upstream provider auth). Not caused by these edits, but it is noisy in logs.

critical_code_review_comments: js/_index.js is ~47.9k lines and js/auto-promo.js ~4.7k lines — far past the maintainable limit; the new helpers (_buildAdminMediaConfirm, _sendAdminMediaToUser, _isPermanentTelegramSendError, markUserDead, _escalationAlertPlan) plus their dev endpoints would be good candidates to extract into a dedicated module (e.g. js/admin-media.js, js/escalation.js) with unit tests.

markUserDead() reasons 'bot_target' and 'no_rights' returned by _isPermanentTelegramSendError fall through to the default 7-day branch of _promoRetestTtlDays; consider whether 'bot_target' should be Infinity (a bot target can never receive) so we stop retesting it forever.

_escalationAlertPlan's ccSecondary also fires at reminderCount >= 3 even when not overdue — intentional per the code comment, but the dev endpoint only covers the overdue path; a check for the '3 reminders, not overdue' case would close the coverage gap.

Non-blocking: the confirm flow keys pendingAdminMedia on a single admin state slot, so a second attachment before confirming silently overwrites the first (the old preview's amcSend then sends the new media). Consider embedding a token in the callback_data (amcSend:<id>) to make the confirmation unambiguous.
seed_data_creation: None — all dev endpoints are pure-helper harnesses with no DB writes.
test_credentials: Not required — /api/dev/* endpoints are open because BOT_ENVIRONMENT=development
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_media_confirm_suite.py -v` for the enhancement regression pack (health, admin-media-reply 9 checks, admin-media-confirm 10, escalation-alert-plan 6, promo-cadence 10, stale-wallet-tap, support-routing). Suite asserts every check is exactly true AND the expected check count, so a dropped check will fail. NEVER POST to /api/telegram/webhook — it writes to the shared live production MongoDB and triggers real Telegram sends. Only /api/dev/... works through the external ingress (/dev/... is internal only).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found in the tested scope; all 41 helper-level checks across the 4 new endpoints plus 2 adjacent regression endpoints returned true, and health is green.
